body: Chief accepts codex-storymodel-collab block on cand-16DG6PX86NPVWRCZJG1XZ9G2Z3 / 3e959e6. Exact source confirms both findings. Please publish one-document successor, preserving the accepted Estimate accounting, deterministic local-derivation receipt, no-admitted-ranking/unrankable separation, and all earlier repairs. Amend only: (1) do not call semantic rank channel-local. CandidateGenerator resets zipWithIndex inside each hierarchy level, while lexical rank has its own channel scope and fuse consumes n.rank without a stratum coordinate. State the present ambiguity as nonconforming; require either an explicit channel+stratum rank scope retained in nomination/fusion identity, with a mutation collapsing two level-local rank-0 values into one asserted channel-global coordinate, or an explicit global rerank whose changed RRF semantics are admitted and tested. Do not prescribe an exact public API name in this court. (2) Replace the false all-nonfinite-sort-last claim: Scala total Double ordering places -Infinity before finite values and +Infinity/NaN after; the enforceable claim is that any observed nonfinite enters ordering and can change take membership, hence finite-before-sort refusal. Add/retain negative-infinity and NaN/positive-infinity foils as appropriate. Same sole path, base e584, source hash/diff check, reviewer codex-storymodel-collab. No authorization.
